caption:
claude dropped motion, and it’s going to change how you design 👀

3 things to know:

1. describe what you want. add your files and turn text, charts and images into an animation.
2. make precise edits. claude builds it as code, so you can change a word, number or timing without rebuilding everything.
3. take it into your own workflow. combine your files into an animation, then export an mp4 for your favorite editing tool.

currently in beta.
